test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

Sam and Teena / had wondering / what to do this weekend.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. had wondering .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is incorrect because of the phrase **"had wondering"**.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"were wondering"** to indicate that Sam and Teena were in the process of thinking.

Correct sentence: *Sam and Teena **were wondering** what to do this weekend*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of Continuous Tense:**

 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + be (was/were) + verb-ing.
 
• **Example:** They were discussing their plans.
 
• **Usage: **Describes an ongoing action in the past.
